title: GlobalFlows regime — today
headline: Cash tightening, borrowing neutral, growth mid, inflation hot, risk risk-on.
story: Cash looks scarce on the level. Real funding looks mixed. Activity looks mixed versus trend. Prices are high versus ~2%. Fear is cheap on the gauges.

duration.label: Duration risk rising
duration.line: Long bonds aren’t getting paid for the risk — inflation and/or funding are in the way, so present value stays under pressure. Real 10y yields are high — discount rates still bite.

credit.label: Credit risk rising
credit.line: Credit risk is waking up — soft growth, wider spreads, or a weak credit impulse mean cash flows look less certain. Bank credit impulse is decelerating this window — private lending is not confirming easy plumbing.

pair.line: Cash over stocks and long bonds
pair.why: Both discount-rate risk and cash-flow risk are up — get paid to wait.

items.name: Cash
items.why: High or scarce funding pays you to sit in bills; cash is the parking place.

tenors.why: Hot inflation or term premium — 30s aren’t getting paid.

items.name: Credit
items.why: Either cash-flow doubt or rising yields — IG gets hit from one side or both.

splits.name: IG
splits.why: Either cash-flow doubt or rising yields — IG gets hit from one side or both.

splits.name: HY
splits.why: Soft growth, draining cash, or rising fear — HY is the first credit to get hurt.

items.name: Equities
items.why: Soft growth, draining cash, or risk-off — equities are out of favor here.
items.note: Crypto follows equities unless it disagrees with the cash story.

items.name: Gold
items.why: Hot prices, fear, or draining cash without a rates squeeze — gold’s usual jobs.

items.name: Commodities
items.why: Commodities are mixed; growth and inflation aren’t both pointing the same way.

confirm: Cash is draining while fear stays cheap — the tape hasn’t priced the liquidity squeeze yet.
Bitcoin is not confirming the cash drain — treat it as an output disagreement, not a liquidity vote.
Stock–bond correlation is rising this window — diversification is weaker; duration and credit can hurt together.
The 10y yield is rising this window — markets are already marking duration risk up.
falsify: Falsify if Risk flips Risk-off or HY blows out while Liquidity stays Tightening.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.teach: Cash looks scarce on the level. Point: funding/parking say less fuel in the pipes.

voters.name: Overnight reverse repo
voters.why: ON RRP 1 — high = ample parked cash

rates.label: Rates
rates.teach: Real funding looks mixed. Split: Bond volatility (MOVE) lean easier; 30-year mortgage rate lean tighter. Point: not clearly cheap or dear.

growth.label: Growth
growth.teach: Activity looks mixed versus trend. Point: no clean boom or bust.

inflation.label: Inflation
inflation.teach: Prices are high versus ~2%. Point: the level is still hot — the impulse row says if it’s cooling.

risk.label: Risk
risk.teach: Fear is cheap on the gauges. Point: vol and credit are quiet.

note: Anchored lights. Impulse default 6m. Meaning = duration/credit/asset classes.
